root_cause_confirmed.symptom: 2 failures on ubuntu-latest CI leg (windows-latest green): test_build_startup_command_frozen, test_build_startup_command_script_mode in test_views_startup_split.StartupCommandTests
root_cause_confirmed.explanation: Fixtures hard-coded Windows-only relative-foreign paths (C:\..., H:\...). startup.build_startup_command() correctly calls os.path.abspath(sys.executable); on POSIX, a non-POSIX-absolute path is prefixed with os.getcwd(), yielding '/src/C:\Program Files\...'. Production contract (native absolute paths -> exact quoted command) is sound on both platforms.
root_cause_confirmed.evidence: Docker python:3.11 repro of exact CI steps: failures=2 before fix; OK (skipped=8) after fix

remediation.approach: native-fixture (preferred): added module helper _fixture_abs_path(*parts, drive='C') building absolute fake paths with host-OS root + os.path.join semantics (nt: '<drive>:' + os.sep; posix: '/'). Assertions remain strict exact assertEqual on the quoted command (f'"{executable}"' and f'"{executable}" "{script}"') - no regex, no substring matching.

attempts.note: helper built 'C\...' without drive colon -> isabs false -> abspath prefixed cwd; corrected f'{drive}:{os.sep}'
